page.layout: One column of running text, with a running head at the top and the page number at the top right. The catchword "IIII. AR-" stands alone at the bottom right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: ἀδελφοῖς[?] & ab Antichristianis affliguntur, ut hoc meminerint, non carere solatio eam persecutionem, quam φιλαληθείας[?] caussa sustinent. Præstat enim confiteri, IESVM CHRISTVM in carne venisse, & eo nomine traduci & exagitari: quàm ὑπομένειν[?] fructum aulicæ beneuolentiæ falsa docendo captare, & breui tempore percipere.
main_text.head: III. ARGUMENTUM, AB EF- ficiente principe.
main_text.p: Nullius opera maioris nobis facienda, & proinde maiore studio cognoscenda sunt, q; eius in quo sumus, uiuimus & mouemur, & qui uniuersorum iudex est.
In Iehouah autem sumus, uiuimus & mouemur. Actor.17.28. Ipse est iudex & moderator omnium.

Quare eius opera summo studio nobis sunt cognoscenda. Atque eo potissimum nomine temulenti grauiter reprehenduntur, quòd opus Iehouæ non respiciant, & opera manuum eius non uideant: Iesa.5.12. Utinam huius temulentiæ nulla, tum in communibus œconomijs, tum præcipuè in aulis, exempla, hoc tempore perturbatissimo, pijs occurrant.

page.notes: The first Greek word of the page and the Greek words φιλαληθείας and ὑπομένειν are uncertain and marked [?]. The word after "q;" was read as "q;" (que). Long s was copied as plain s throughout, including where the scan shows an f-like form (sumus, sunt, summo, potissimum). The IIII. AR- at the foot is a catchword for the next page. The heading "III. ARGUMENTUM" is set over two lines and kept as one head.
